channel.title: CreArtBox · News
channel.description: Season announcements, notes from the road, and what the ensemble is working on now.

item.title: Upsidedown Creek is a real place
item.description: Eric Moe on the piece CreArtBox plays on 30 October. The creek is a real one in Montana, the sign at the trailhead really is upside down, and the music came partly from a tango.

item.title: CreArtBox announces its twelfth season
item.description: Four productions at The DiMenna Center for Classical Music, eleven works chosen from the ensemble's open call, one world premiere, touring dates in Illinois, Kentucky and the Hudson Valley, a residency in Finland, and the seventh Festival ADAR in Asturias.
